request.description:
Creates a credit note that reverses the invoice's totals and stock
movements, and marks the original invoice as cancelled. The invoice
stays in the system; it is not deleted.

{"message": "Esta factura no se puede cancelar."}

Devolución parcial (o total, si se indican todas las cantidades
disponibles) de una factura. A diferencia de cancel(), la factura
original no queda cancelada.

immediately reduces stock for each product. If `unit_price` is
omitted for a line, the price is resolved from the customer's price
list (see PriceResolutionService).

full amount to `invoice_id`. Use `GET /api/v1/payment-methods` to get
valid `payment_method_id` values; `detail` fields depend on the
method's `detail_type` (bank_transfer, card, cash, bizum, cheque,
generic) — see App\Support\PaymentDetailType.
